prompt: do a 2D nozzle flow simulation using interfoam solver and  Spalart-Allmaras turbulence model. Use a time step of 1e-8 seconds, output results every 1e-06s. The end time is 1e-5 s. Set nuTilda to 1.7856e-05 m^2/s in the domain and at the inlet, and nuTilda = 0 (fixedValue) on the walls. Do not use more than 7500 cells in your mesh.
adaptation: 源称2D但网格为角度楔形，解释为无旋流轴对称，保留子午面几何。
入口速度、密度、黏度、表面张力、初始空气来自源配置；q按prompt覆盖源0值；接触角明确补足90度。
输出均值采用2πr权重；不把压力转为运动学压力或假定可压缩。
status: statements-only; no data, reference, runtime registration or calibration
